resources.string: Detects your configured controller button combinations in every app and in the stream (back to GameLodge, quick menu, mouse emulation), and passes a keyboard\'s keys that Android would take itself (Alt+Tab, the Windows key) to the streamed PC. In mouse emulation it taps and swipes where the pointer is. Only controller and keyboard keys are read, nothing on the screen.
Mouse emulation outside the stream needs the system-wide combo service (Settings → Controllers)
